properties.notes: Redundant waterworks site within Tweedmouth, with existing infrastructure remaining in situ, but which offers opportunity for redevelopment. A hybrid application was permitted in May 2019 for 6 dwellings (in full) with a further 4 (in outline) to follow (18/01164/OUT). This proposal will involve demolition of a reservoir and the former pumping station prior to new-build development. Given the recent approval of this application, no start has been made on residential development to date.
